verdict: OK to lend in Pithampur auto components, but only to EV-agnostic, OEM-diversified suppliers with tight monthly monitoring; avoid single-OEM, ICE-engine-concentrated borrowers.
title: Pithampur Auto & Auto Components: a note to the credit manager
narrative:
## What this business physically is
Pithampur is a 4,500-hectare cluster with over 30 OEMs, 200-plus component makers and 1,000-plus equipment producers, employing more than 25,000 people [3]. **A component borrower here buys metal, plastics and electronics, converts them on presses and machining lines, and sells into an OEM's assembly schedule.** Cash is made on conversion margin per part, not on the metal; value sits in the tooling and the approved-vendor position, and cash sits in receivables from a handful of large OEMs. Note [3] is from February 2025, so treat cluster counts as dated. ## What has changed now
National auto output (NIC 29) is +25.2% YoY and +19.2% Apr-to-date [D], and peer results confirm demand: Motherson Sumi Wiring revenue +46.7% to Rs 4,054 crore and profit +35% to Rs 223 crore [4], while Lumax lifted its growth outlook [7]. **But bank credit to the sector is running +27.0% YoY against +19.2% output, a +7.8 pp gap [D] — some of the lending is funding working capital stretch, not just volume.** Locally, Madhya Pradesh GST is -0.1% Apr-to-date versus India +6.1% [D], so the state is not sharing the national momentum. Margin pressure is real: ASK Automotive reports aluminium squeezing margins [5], and Elara expects Q4FY26 EBITDA growth of about 21% with commodity risk [6]. ## Where the growth is
EKA Mobility has inaugurated six plants across Pune and Pithampur within an 11-facility, 120-acre network, capacity above 40,000 EVs and investment over Rs 3,500 crore [1][2]. **Pursue tier-2 suppliers feeding this EV build-out — battery enclosures, seating, interiors, bus body — and EV-agnostic precision parts houses.** Avoid borrowers whose order book is one ICE engine platform: CRISIL flags engine-part suppliers as facing higher obsolescence risk as EVs spread [11]. ## How to grow safely
Structure term loans to the tooling and capex actually ordered, and keep working capital as a separate, annually reviewed limit. Cap debt/EBITDA at 2.5-2.75 times [10]. ## Early-warning signs
- Monthly GST filed late or turnover falling while bank turnover holds (monthly) -> freeze enhancement, inspect stock. - Debt/EBITDA above 2.5-2.75 times (quarterly) -> stop new capex funding, restructure.

## Verdict
**Lend at OK, selectively: EV-linked and diversified component makers in Pithampur, with monthly covenants; decline single-OEM ICE-dependent proposals.**
